description: Analyze and extract information from one or more images using Gemini multimodal understanding. Returns a text analysis - no image is generated. Default model: gemini-3.1-pro-preview. DO NOT SET max_tokens - the server allocates the model's full output ceiling automatically; a small cap is spent on Gemini 3 thinking and returns empty output that looks like a timeout. [MCP_RECOMMENDED_TIMEOUT_MS: 300000]

global_media_resolution.description: Global image quality for cost optimization. MEDIUM recommended for PDFs (50% savings).

images.description: One or more images to analyze

filePath.description: Local file path to the image (alternative to base64 data). The image is loaded server-side, bypassing MCP transport limits. Use the filePath returned by load_image_from_path.

mediaResolution.description: Per-image resolution override. LOW=280 tokens (75% savings), MEDIUM=560 tokens (50% savings), HIGH=1120 tokens (default), ULTRA_HIGH=2000+ tokens (max detail, per-image only)

mimeType.description: MIME type of the image (e.g., image/png, image/jpeg). Required when using data, auto-detected from filePath.

thoughtSignature.description: Thought signature from a previous generate_image or edit_image call. Required for conversational editing with Gemini 3 Pro Image. Pass the thoughtSignature from the previous response to maintain edit context.

max_tokens.description: Output token budget INCLUDING Gemini 3 thinking tokens. OMIT THIS — the server allocates the model's full output ceiling (a cap, not consumption; unused headroom costs nothing). Values below 4096 are IGNORED; values above the model's real limit are clamped.

model.description: Omit to use gemini-3.1-pro-preview (strongest reasoning). Other valid options: gemini-3.8-flash (fast, GA), gemini-3-pro-preview, gemini-3-flash-preview. Do NOT pass gemini-1.5-* or gemini-pro-vision — those are out of support.

prompt.description: What to analyze or extract from the image(s)

name: analyze_image
title: Analyze Image
